resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent CCXI-prepared credit rating / bond disclosure documents (one for Jiangxi Natural Gas Group, one an SSE bond report referencing Jiangxi Investment Group) both confirm the 54%/46% split for 江西省天然气管道有限公司, the entity operating the whole province network including P4790. Precision note: the SSE report names the 46% holder more specifically as '国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司（原中国石化管道储运有限公司）' — a PipeChina Group subsidiary — rather than the parent group directly; this is consistent with, not contradicting, the sheet's parent-level attribution, flagged for awareness not as a value change. This same Operator/Owner unit and both refs apply identically to P4792, P5859 and P5860 below (shared owner across the whole Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network entity).

resolutions.researcher_notes: [Phase II, Jingkai District-Jishui-Yongfeng-Le'an-Yihuang Gas Pipeline] CROSS-SHARD OPERATOR TENSION (filed by the coordinator, not by a research shard -- this row's own shard never saw the evidence). Batch_03 established from TWO independent documents -- the CCXI 2022 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 and the quannan.gov.cn wrfz2.pdf emergency-response plan, whose own 运行单位 field names the parent Group directly -- that the 54%/46% JV (江西省天然气管道有限公司 + 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司) operates PHASE I only (川气东送-sourced), while PHASE II (西气东输-sourced) runs under the Group's own 管道分公司 internal division with no JV/PipeChina involvement. THIS ROW IS EXPLICITLY PHASE II per its SegmentName, and its shard staged the 54/46 JV against Operator [ref]. Nine Phase II rows are in scope (P4785/P4786/P4787/P4788/P4789/P4790/P4791/P5860/P5863); batch_03's own sentinel covers P4786-P4788, so this record widens the same finding to the rows its author could not see. TWO CAVEATS, both against overreading this: (1) the staged value sits in the QCCOwner(业主单位) column -- an OWNER/proprietor-unit fact from the QCC business registry -- whereas batch_03's evidence concerns the 运行单位 (OPERATING unit). Those are different facts and the JV may well be a correct Phase II owner even if it is the wrong operator, so this is a question to adjudicate, NOT an established contradiction. (2) All nine rows are currently BLANK for Operator and Owner on the operators/owners tab (GID 1489950650, verified against the 20260902 snapshot), so nothing is at risk of being overwritten -- the only decision is which proposal, if any, gets pasted. NO value, ref, class or tier has been changed on any shard record. Recommend adjudicating the Phase I/Phase II operator split ONCE for the whole cohort rather than row by row.
